ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: there are two bar charts, one above the other, in the figure. The title of the upper chart is “Non-breeding season”, and the vertical axis is the average T level; the bar heights of helper males and breeding males are similar, both about 10, indicating that the T levels of both types of males are low in the non-breeding season. The title of the lower chart is “Breeding season”; the average T level of helper males is still about 10, while the average T level of breeding males increases markedly, to about 50. Then reason: the question stem states that helper males mainly help raise related offspring, while breeding males establish territories and actually participate in reproduction. Comparing the data from the two seasons shows that T does not increase with the season in all males, but increases significantly in breeding males during the breeding season. Therefore, testosterone is positively correlated with reproductive activity in this species, and its role is to help or promote reproduction.

raw_record.question_text: According to the following two histograms, what role does testosterone (T) play in reproduction in this species?

method.method_draft: 先描述图像：上图为非繁殖季，帮助雄性和繁殖雄性的平均T水平相近且都低；下图为繁殖季，繁殖雄性的T水平明显高于帮助雄性。再结合题干中两类雄性的繁殖角色，比较可见T只在真正繁殖的雄性、且在繁殖季显著升高。因此推断睾丸激素在该物种中有助于或促进繁殖。
method.CoT_raw: 先描述图像：图中有上下两个柱状图。上图标题为“Non-breeding season”，纵轴是平均T水平；帮助雄性和繁殖雄性的柱子高度相近，都约为10，说明非繁殖季两类雄性的T水平都低。下图标题为“Breeding season”，帮助雄性的平均T水平仍约为10，而繁殖雄性的平均T水平明显升高，约为50。再推理：题干说明帮助雄性主要帮助抚养亲缘后代，而繁殖雄性建立领地并真正参与繁殖。比较两季数据可见，T并不是在所有雄性中都随季节升高，而是在繁殖季的繁殖雄性中显著升高。因此，睾丸激素与该物种的繁殖活动正相关，作用是有助于或促进繁殖。
method.model_answer: 睾丸激素（T）在该物种中有助于繁殖或促进繁殖。
method.answer_match_reason: 预测答案明确表示睾丸激素有助于或促进繁殖，与标准答案“有助于繁殖”语义一致。
